asset.name: Celebration
asset.description: The restrained milestone feedback with configurable intensity, optional haptics or sound, reduced-motion collapse, and a usage policy that keeps it meaningful.

requires.reason: Spacing, radius, and semantic colour resolve to declared ramps.
Effects collapse entirely under reduced-motion policy.

rationale: Carries the celebration-budget capability explicitly. In a system where agents complete work continuously, celebrating every completion makes none of them mean anything and makes the interface exhausting to sit in front of.
